findings.finding: m_Undef matches scalar UndefValue and PoisonValue, and aggregate constants whose elements are undef/poison. It is not an undef-only predicate. The repo inventory source snapshots omit PatternMatch.h; this evidence is from the pinned external checkout artifact.
findings.recommendation: Review each inventory entry whose match_details or source pattern says undef: distinguish actual undef (uninterpreted in Puddle) from poison (modeled), and aggregate/vector forms. Do not blanket-mark the whole rewrite unsupported solely because one matched alternative is undef; a distinct poison-only declarative specialization may be expressible.

findings.finding: For scalar V, this returns the operand unchanged for either undef or poison. Puddle's lack of undef does not preclude a poison-only identity specialization. Current entry describes only undef and its unsupported blocker hides that scalar poison case.
findings.recommendation: Split/retarget a poison-only scalar specialization as pending for proof review; retain an undef-specific entry as unsupported. Avoid asserting the whole m_Undef branch is unsupported.

findings.finding: Every m_Undef occurrence in the InstCombine source inventory was scanned. Scalar/general occurrences include InstCombineNegator.cpp:113 (negator-L125a), InstCombineLoadStoreAlloca.cpp:1263, InstCombineVectorOps.cpp:2126, InstCombineVectorOps.cpp:3061, and InstructionCombining.cpp:5465/5509/5525 (freeze family). Composite or vector matching occurs in InstCombineVectorOps.cpp:1490, 1751, 1820, 2452, 2916-19, 3038, 3433; InstCombineCompares.cpp:3639, 7666-73; InstructionCombining.cpp:2682; InstCombineCalls.cpp:1715; InstCombineMulDivRem.cpp:1337; InstCombineSelect.cpp:1107 and 5301-15; InstCombineSimplifyDemanded.cpp:1635. The latter families are vector/aggregate/mask/combined patterns; preserve their vector or context-specific blockers, but ensure scalar poison subcases are not hidden by a blanket undef limitation.
findings.recommendation: For each source family, inspect adjacent type/pattern guards before splitting. In particular, never treat aggregate/vector m_Undef support as equivalent to scalar poison support.

source_evidence.text: if (llvm::isGuaranteedNotToBeUndefOrPoison(Op0, Q.AC, Q.CtxI, Q.DT)) return Op0;

findings.finding: This visitor arm delegates to InstructionSimplify; it returns operand only when proven non-undef and non-poison. In particular, freeze(poison) does not preempt the later freeze(undef-or-poison) replacement path.
findings.recommendation: Mark as delegation/dispatch and avoid counting a separate local rewrite. Existing capability blocker is appropriate for semantic proof of the external simplifier, but not a distinct visitFreeze rewrite.

findings.finding: This arm dispatches to two substantive helpers, one generic PHI fold and one recurrence fold. The inventory description combines distinct possible transforms.
findings.recommendation: Keep substantive helper implementations inventoried as rewrites where present; classify this visitor line as dispatch/delegation or narrow it to a call-site family without counting it as a third independent rewrite.

findings.finding: The substantive transformation is returned by pushFreezeToPreventPoisonFromPropagating; visitor arm is a dispatch plus common replacement.
findings.recommendation: Represent as a delegation/helper dispatch if that helper's rewrite is already inventoried, to avoid duplicate rewrite counts.

findings.finding: The shared-use choice is not limited to constants. The m_c_Select arm (lines 5491-5493) can bind an arbitrary other select arm V, accepts it when V is not self and guaranteed non-undef/non-poison, and otherwise falls back to null. The all-ones choice for OR and boolean choice for constant select cases are further alternatives.
findings.recommendation: Broaden description/rewrite_details from constant-only to a chosen safe value (which may be arbitrary SSA V), while retaining consistent-across-all-uses constraint. Its source match m_Undef also includes poison.

findings.finding: The shuffle test only blocks the use-choice transform; otherwise it calls the same getUndefReplacement and replaces all uses. It is a guard/wrapper over ic-freeze-undef-use-choice-L5446, not an additional rewrite. The check catches direct and bitcast-mediated shuffle use.
findings.recommendation: Reclassify as guard/analysis or fold into the use-choice entry; avoid counting a separate rewrite. Preserve the vector-shuffle blocker for the guard itself.

findings.finding: This duplicates the already-inventoried freezeOtherUses implementation at L5366, which moves freeze, replaces dominated uses, and queues users.
findings.recommendation: Mark this visitor arm as dispatch/delegation linked to ic-freeze-other-uses-L5366, not another rewrite.

findings.finding: Under a deterministic Puddle freeze choice, freeze(poison) feeding OR can be assigned the model's chosen value (e.g. zero), making OR produce zero while the LLVM visitor's valid choice for OR is all-ones. LLVM freeze(poison) may choose an arbitrary fixed non-poison value, so InstCombine's all-ones outcome is legal; the mismatch demonstrates that the current deterministic model choice is too narrow for this refinement argument, not an LLVM bug.
findings.recommendation: Do not record this as an LLVM counterexample. The L7707 simplifier evidence confirms poison input is not returned unchanged first.

findings.finding: The narrowed inventory span 3375-3421 and matched opcode only getelementptr correctly isolate the local normalization family; preceding simplifyGEPInst and demanded-vector dispatches are separately represented by ic-gep-simplify-dispatch-L3351 and ic-gep-demanded-vector-dispatch-L3360. Scalar/vector cast opcodes are outputs, not source matched producers. However, Puddle's single dynamic-index GEP uses unsigned index-to-natural interpretation, so i8 -1 sext-to-i64 and zext-to-i64 yield different modeled addresses; the source's signed extension case cannot be assumed covered by current GEP semantics.
findings.recommendation: Keep the source boundary and separate dispatch rows. Treat narrow signed-index normalization as requiring cast/GEP interpreter alignment or a tightly proven modeled specialization; do not infer support merely from generic sext and one-index GEP capabilities.

findings.finding: The actual rewrite is scalar smin plus nsw sub and the guard excludes undef for a free SSA operand. This does not match an undef opcode; it relies on a source analysis fact. Since Puddle's runtime value is deterministic scalar/poison and has no undef, this guard may be vacuously true for the modeled domain. That is separate from proving the rewrite itself.
findings.recommendation: Don't classify the rule as blocked solely by absent undef opcode interpretation; preserve exact ssa-analysis guard in audit and let proof review determine validity over modeled runtime values.

source_evidence.text: Division/remainder pattern additionally applies one-use checks.
Nonzero NewC requires remainder product one-use.

findings.finding: This is scalar algebra with exact matching x and constants, source-specific profitability/use guards, and an analysis guard excluding undef. The operation duplicates an arbitrary SSA X between an original quotient-derived expression and a fresh multiplication; the guard is an LLVM per-use undef correlation condition. A Puddle deterministic runtime domain may make this guard redundant, but this review does not decide semantic validity of the algebraic rewrite.
findings.recommendation: Record actual source guard as analysis-based exclusion of undef, not a matched undef operand. Leave proof truth to the worker; don't make missing undef opcode semantics by itself the unsupported reason for the modeled scalar subset.

quick_scan.findings: Freeze visit arms L5428, L5435, L5442 and L5539 are dispatch wrappers around helpers or an external simplifier; L5509 is a guard followed by the shared L5446 replacement. Source-to-helper rows that describe no independent local action should generally use kind=delegation/analysis-helper, not kind=rewrite with empty rewrite_opcodes.
quick_scan.evidence: GEP has correctly separated analogous dispatch rows: ic-gep-simplify-dispatch-L3351 and ic-gep-demanded-vector-dispatch-L3360.

limitations: This review is source/inventory only. It recommends inventory distinctions and proof-review follow-up; it does not establish Lean proof validity or alter statuses.

Reclassified five freeze dispatch wrappers as delegations, restored four scalar-capable source families to pending, corrected shared freeze replacement description, and retained the refined GEP boundaries. Formal counterexamples are not credited by this source-only report.
